subject: Quarry
author: Paul_Dnap
body: I quite like the quarry for stunt runs; my best stunt so far was in there, especially if you come accross the bridge first then drift your way up to the quarry. If you can get a double barrel roll going in (it's also super jump) then get the billboard in the towers up the big ramp near where you land, that takes you anticlock wise up the road, there's a billboard you can get off to the left (flatspin off) you can then go clockwise round to the third billboard. Then if you're brave you can go for a barrel roll, but I always chicken that and get out the side of the quarry to in the little passase that leads to the superjump at the foot of the damn and head back into habour town
